description.zh:
检查项的ID。

> 您可调用[ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~)接口获取检查项ID。
description.en:
The ID of the check item.

> You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to query the IDs of check items.

description.zh: 检查项自定义配置项列表。
description.en: The custom configuration items of the check item.

description.zh: 检查项自定义配置项名称，同检查项唯一。
description.en: The name of the custom configuration item. The name of a custom configuration item is unique in a check item.

description.zh: 检查项自定义配置项操作类型，只有删除时传DELETE，创建和更新不用传。
description.en: The operation that you want to perform on the custom configuration item. This parameter is required only if you want to delete the custom configuration item. To delete the custom configuration item, set the value to DELETE.

description.zh: 检查项自定义配置项用户配置值字符串。
description.en: The value of the custom configuration item. The value is a string.

description.zh:
云安全中心实例地域。取值为：

- **cn-hangzhou：**  中心
- **ap-southeast-1：**  新加坡
description.en:
The region where the Security Center instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: International
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Singapore

description.zh: 检查项修复功能支持的修复参数。
description.en: The parameters required for fixing risk items.

description.zh: 修复时对应修复流程的ID。
description.en: The ID of the fixing process.

description.zh: 检查项修复参数名称，同检查项唯一。
description.en: The name of the parameter required for fixing a risk item, which is unique in a check item.

description.zh: 检查项自定义配置项操作类型，只有删除时传DELETE，创建和更新不用传。
description.en: The operation that you want to perform on the custom configuration item. This parameter is required only if you want to delete the custom configuration item. To delete the custom configuration item, set the value to DELETE.

description.zh: 检查项修复配置项用户配置值字符串。
description.en: The value of the parameter required for fixing a risk item. The value is a string.

title.zh: 修改检查项自定义配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas change-check-custom-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --check-id 76 --custom-configs Value=13 Operation=DELETE Name=SessionTimeMax --repair-configs FlowId=ascgrmscyjgs000000000 Value=80 Operation=DELETE Name=Port --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ChangeCheckCustomConfig --region cn-hangzhou --RepairConfigs.1.Name Port --RepairConfigs.1.FlowId ascgrmscyjgs000000000 --CheckId 76 --RepairConfigs.1.Value 80 --CustomConfigs.1.Name SessionTimeMax --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --CustomConfigs.1.Operation DELETE --CustomConfigs.1.Value 13 --RepairConfigs.1.Operation DELETE
